name: LinkedIn content engine pipeline
description: Research topics → generate & score drafts → optional LinkedIn compose (Post not clicked in dry-run). Artifacts under data/content/<runId>/.

env.name: CONTENT_DRY_RUN
env.description: Propagates to all steps (still writes artifacts; never publishes)

env.name: CONTENT_RUN_ID
env.description: Reuse run; unset creates new id on research

env.name: CONTENT_PIPELINE_FROM
env.description: Optional step id to start from

env.name: CONTENT_PIPELINE_TO
env.description: Optional step id to stop after
